description: This file defines a UI component 'NoteListItem' using LightningJS framework. The component displays note information such as title, preview, last updated time, and handles selection logic. It imports external modules for styling, state management, and utility functions.

classes.name: NoteListItem
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a list item for notes, including display of title, preview, and timestamp, along with selection handling.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Public method that dispatches a note selection action to the store, using the note ID.
